title: Video Capture Interface
text: Simulate capture of images from video stream on hardware, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Input} sets Source of simulated video data From; {Value} sets the image to be imported uint8, {Object name} sets the timeseries object name, {Sample time} and {Show event port} sets the option to enable task event ports. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Input
params.values: Source of simulated video data From dialog (default) | From input port | From timeseries object

params.name: Value
params.values: Image to be imported uint8(floor(rand(1,3*160*120)*255)) (default) | 3 M N -element vector

params.name: Object name
params.values: Timeseries object name [] (default) | MATLAB workspace variable

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time in seconds -1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Show event port
params.values: Option to enable task event ports off (default) | on
